observation: Page title is the bare brand name on A. B's title adds a tagline.
evidence: A title 'AEP Texas'; B title 'AEP Texas | Knowledge Is Power'.

observation: A uses a custom webfont, din-2014, on every measured element. B uses a system Helvetica Neue/Arial stack.
evidence: A fonts_by_element_count: din-2014 1382. B: Helvetica Neue 126, Arial 6.

observation: A's headings and nav are mostly uppercase condensed DIN. B uses sentence/title case for the nav, hero and section headings, and uppercase only for the card titles.
evidence: A h1 'KNOWLEDGE IS POWER.', nav 'MY ACCOUNT', 'BRING HOME ENERGY SAVINGS'. B h1 'Knowledge is power.', nav 'My Account', 'Bring Home Energy Savings', card h3 'GET REVVED UP FOR ELECTRIC CARS'.

observation: The body text on A is larger and lighter. B's body text is smaller.
evidence: A body 20px/30px, color rgb(74,74,74). B body 16px/24.8px, color rgb(34,36,38).

observation: A's hero h1 is dark brick red and 66px. B's h1 is brighter brand red and 72px.

A's hero text is left-aligned at the page margin, with a subtext paragraph directly beneath the h1. B's h1 sits in a centered-left column starting around x=460, with the subtext in a white callout box with a red left border.
evidence: A slice 0 hero text at x≈70. B hero h1 at x≈460, and a white box with a red left rule holds the scam notice.

observation: A's hero scam message ends in a red circular play-arrow icon link. B's has no icon and places the text in a boxed callout.
evidence: A 'your family safe.' followed by a red circle arrow. B has a plain boxed paragraph.

observation: The header on A is a tall white bar with a gray utility strip above it, then a thick red rule under the header. B has a thinner header with a light beige utility strip and a thin gray border.
evidence: A logo at y=75, 92x70; red line at about y=172. B logo at y=45, 68x52.

observation: A's nav items are uppercase and sit right-aligned beside the Log In button and a search icon. B's nav links sit left, next to the logo, with Log in at the far right and no search icon.
evidence: A nav MY ACCOUNT..CONTACT at x 455–1140, then LOG IN and a magnifier. B links at x 260–736, Log in at x 1180.

observation: A's 'Español' link has a globe icon, repeated in the footer. B shows 'Español' as plain text.
evidence: A has a globe glyph by ESPAÑOL at the top and in the footer. B has text only.

observation: A's quick-link bar is a translucent white strip over the hero image, with colored line icons (blue, orange, teal, green) and vertical dividers. B's is a solid red bar of four centered white text links with no icons.
evidence: A 'ELECTRIC CHOICE', 'REPORT AN OUTAGE' etc. with circular icons. B red rgb(218,41,28) band with plain text.

observation: A's page is mostly white with light-gray (243) dividers. B alternates white sections with a beige band (244,242,238) and a gray promo band.
A's secondary buttons are white with a thin dark outline and dark text. B's are solid red with white bold text, and one is outlined red.
evidence: A 'Learn about incentives', 'Track your order' as outlined boxes. B same labels in solid red; 'How we're helping' red outline. The A LOG IN button is red with an 8px radius.

observation: A has the LED tip as a centered block with a green bulb icon and an outlined 'See how' button. B has it as a white card with a red top border, a soft shadow and a red underlined 'See how →' text link.
evidence: A has a green bulb icon and a 'See how' button. B has one box-shadow in total and a card with a red top border.

observation: A's 'Bring Home Energy Savings' heading is red uppercase DIN. B's is a near-black title-case bold sans heading on a beige band.
evidence: A h2 32px, red. B h2 36.8px, rgb(34,36,38) text.

observation: A presents the three promos as image-background banners with text overlaid on the photos: a full-width EV banner, then two half-width banners. B presents three equal cards with the image on top and red uppercase titles in a bordered white body below.
evidence: A EV image 1300x449 at full content width; two images 620x335. B three images each 355x200 in a 3-column grid.

observation: The same photo file is cropped differently. The EV image is 1302x450 rendered at 1300x449 on A and 355x200 on B.
evidence: electric-car-image-aep-texas.jpg rect A w1300 h449; B w355 h200.

observation: A draws the promo titles in white or dark text over the photos. B's card titles are red uppercase text outside the images.
evidence: A 'GET REVVED UP FOR ELECTRIC CARS' white on photo. B same text in red on a white card.

observation: A's outage-alert row is white and framed by gray rules, with an orange lightning icon, an orange heading and an outlined button. B's is a full-width gray (112,115,114) band with a white heading and body and a white 'Sign up today' button with red text.
evidence: A 'Enroll in outage alerts' in orange. B band bg rgb(112,115,114).

observation: A lays out the three lower promos as three equal columns with image, h3, text and outlined button stacked. B stacks them as full-width alternating image/text rows (zigzag).
evidence: A images 393x278 at x=70, 523, 977. B images 532x376 at x=160 and x=748, alternating at y=1756, 2196, 2636.

observation: The headings for the three promos are h3 on A and h2 on B, so B's outline is flatter.
evidence: A h3 'View Your Meter Order Status'. B h2 for the same text.

observation: A's footer has a red band of four nav labels, then a white area with an outlined phone button, a globe, links and social icons. B's footer is a dark charcoal block with text links, the phone number as large white text and plain-text social links.
evidence: A red band rgb(218,41,28) with SAFETY/COMPANY... and Twitter/f/YouTube icons. B footer bg rgb(42,44,45) with 'Twitter Facebook YouTube' as text.

observation: A's content width runs from x=70 to x=1370. B's is narrower, from x=160 to x=1280.
evidence: A images at x=70 w1300. B logo and content at x=160, Log in ends at 1280.

observation: A has far more DOM nodes and a deep div structure. B's is compact.
evidence: A div 638, span 106, a 267, li 240. B div 30, span 1, a 37, li 13.

observation: B uses semantic landmarks that A lacks. A has only nav and footer.
evidence: A header 0, main 0, section 0, aside 0. B header 1, main 1, section 3, aside 1, footer 1.

observation: A includes a hidden privacy policy, video modal, handbook selector and processing overlay, so its heading outline is long.
evidence: A headings 'Processing your request', 'Select your state handbook', 'Loading video...', 'Privacy Policy...' with h4 Scope, Consent, etc.; h6 30. B outline has 10 headings, none for these.

observation: A's login and security modals are present in the DOM. B includes a single dialog element with a form.
evidence: A h3 'Security Code', 'What Does Remember User ID Mean?', 'Welcome back!', iframe 1, form 1, input 9. B dialog 1, form 1, input 3, h2 'Welcome back!'.

observation: A relies on many scripts and a heavy class vocabulary. B has one script, one style block and no stylesheet links.
evidence: A script 26, stylesheets 4, classes total 1597 unique 294. B script 1, stylesheets 0, style 1, classes total 46 unique 28.

observation: A uses many inline style attributes and ARIA attributes. B uses few.
evidence: A inline_style_attrs 26, aria_attrs 141. B 3 and 6.

observation: A's content images have empty alt text, apart from the logo and a loading gif, and one img is missing alt. B gives descriptive alt text to all images.
evidence: A alt_missing 1; alts '' for the car, woman, meter and other images. B alts such as 'Electric car charging', 'Power lines during an outage'; alt_missing 0.

observation: A includes tracking pixels and a loading gif in the image set. B has only 7 content images and no pixels.
evidence: A images include px, pixel.gif and animated-bulb-processing.gif, 11 imgs. B 7 imgs.

observation: A draws icons as images or sprites. B uses text glyphs for icons, such as the ☰ menu button and the → arrow.
evidence: A svgs 0, with icons shown visually. B primary_button text '☰' and a 'See how →' link.

observation: B uses CSS grid and has few flex containers. A uses flex heavily and no grid.
evidence: A display_grid 0, display_flex 235. B grid 6, flex 14.

observation: B has a box shadow and rounded corners on its cards. A has no box-shadows and mostly square corners.
evidence: A box_shadows 0, radius 0 on 1346 elements. B box_shadows 1, radius 1–7px on 16 elements.

observation: A defines many CSS transitions. B defines few.
evidence: A transitions 291. B transitions 10.

observation: B's primary measured button is a hamburger toggle (☰) with a transparent background. This suggests a mobile menu that is hidden at desktop width. A's primary button is the red LOG IN.
evidence: B primary_button text '☰', bg rgba(0,0,0,0). A primary_button 'LOG IN' bg rgb(218,41,28), radius 8px, padding 0 27px.

observation: B's page is slightly shorter, and its hero is shorter, than A's.
evidence: A page_height 3372. B 3343. A hero spans about y=175–620. B hero spans about y=110–550.

observation: Both pages keep the same copy, photos, a single h1 and the same 1440px page width.
evidence: Both h1_count 1; words 301 vs 295; both have 2 emoji and 1 em dash; same image filenames.

observation: B adds a meta description. A has cache-control, pragma and google-site-verification meta tags.
evidence: A meta_names google-site-verification, cache-control, pragma, viewport. B charset, viewport, description.

observation: In B the footer link text is light gray (214,214,212) on charcoal. A's text is mostly dark gray (74,74,74) on white, with red used for emphasis.
